description: The standard natural numbers satisfy \(\Box_T A\to A\) for every arithmetic sentence \(A\) if and only if every actual \(T\)-theorem is true in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FormalizedProvability.standard_reflection_iff_sound
  {T : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Theory}
  (P : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FormalizedProvability.ProofRepresentation T) :
  (∀ (σ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence),
      ℕ ⊨ FirstOrder.Language.Formula.imp (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FormalizedProvability.provabilitySentence P σ) σ) ↔
    ∀ (σ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T σ → ℕ ⊨ σ
